problem_type: Workspace selection is not restored before lane creation
symptom: A cold app restart opens empty main instead of the last selected conversation; deleting main and reopening resurrects a new main session.
direct_cause: openLaneWorkspace opens options.laneName or main before reading the real SDK session list and has no persisted project selection.
class_root: The workspace owner treats its first-run seed as a durable current selection and fails to bind a selection to an existing session identity before opening.
affected_population: Projects whose main conversation was deleted
Stale or malformed project selection metadata
entry_points: Model attachment to the current conversation
internal_only_reason: Installed pi 0.85.1 harness/session/types.d.ts:399-407 and jsonl/types.d.ts:22-27 expose only per-session metadata, not a project current selection. Session value storage is per transcript; using it would require reading all sessions or creating a fake workspace session. This project-level UI choice is owned by Nomi and uses its existing atomic JSON writer.
invariants: Read the SDK list before choosing or creating a lane; only a genuinely empty list may seed main.
Persist only the selected laneName and sessionId; the SDK remains the sole list/transcript authority.
A stale or malformed pointer can only select an existing SDK session, never create its missing target or replace another identity.
Publish and persist a replacement only after its host opens; same-identity model attachment and cold reads do not rewrite selection or transcript.
generality_proof: Executing and history-only opens both converge on laneWorkspace selection. The saved identity is verified against repo.list before opening, so no renderer persistence or provider-specific branch can resurrect deleted sessions.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Resolve, persist and publish one active existing session while keeping resource lifetime serialized.
Read only a validated project-local selection pointer; unknown or corrupt choices confer no session authority.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Real two-process UX stage4-switch walk and child-process SDK fixture previously reopen empty main instead of selected research.
Real two-process agent-lane-deletion walk and SDK fixture show main recreated despite a surviving replacement lane.
The low-level session API deliberately permits explicit create/open; workspace selection must resolve existing identity before using it.

recurrence.reason: Any workspace restart with a non-main current selection or deleted main can repeat this seed/restore conflation.
same_class_scan: Checked pi SessionMetadata, JsonlSessionMetadata, Repo.list and Session values; none exposes a project current selection.
Searched current workspace, main desktop runtime and renderer workbench persistence; there is no existing selected-lane field.
Checked lifecycle structural queue, close-during-open and no-op model attachment against the new persistence boundary.

prevention.invariant: Resolve a verified existing selection before allowing the session opener to create anything.
prevention.failure_mode: Malformed/stale selection is ignored in favor of an existing SDK session; IO or persistence failures close any newly opened host and reject admission.
prevention.strategy: Store a single identity pointer through existing atomic JSON persistence, resolve it against SDK list, and update it only for a successful changed selection.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove unconditional default-main opening before list resolution; no compatibility fallback or second conversation index remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency change. This project-level selection does not exist in pi per-session metadata; no framework serialization is duplicated.

migration: Existing projects without a selection pointer choose an existing SDK-listed conversation. An actually empty project alone creates a default conversation. No conversation content is rewritten.
residual_risks: Root and runner rerun the real Electron two-process walks after incorporating the production change.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The workspace owns the project-wide active choice and all structural transitions; a lane owns only its own transcript.
